notes.title: Exonautis Kickstarter Launched!
notes.content:
Hi exonauts, 

We have just launched our Kickstarter Campaign, check it out and support Exonautis here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/exonautis/exonautis-explore-the-depths-of-a-vast-alien-ocean

My goal with this campaign is to be able to raise enough funds to dedicate myself full time to Exonautis and create the best possible game that I can. I truly want to create a mesmerizing alien world that players can get lost in, one which this amazing community deserves. You can read more about the plans for the Kickstarter and the game by clicking the link above.

Thank you so much for the amazing support everyone, and will post more updates soon.

Petru

notes.title: Exonautis Demo 01 released!
notes.content:
To all exonauts, 

I am happy to announce that the Exonautis Demo 01 has officially released. This is an early development build and as such will have bugs and performance issues, but I am confident that it can provide an enjoyable gameplay experience and hopefully showcase a vision for the future of the game. So let’s dive into the world of Planet Eo-III together, and feel free to join our discord server if you want to join our community and learn more about the game.

Much love,

Petru

notes.title: Welcome to EXONAUTIS
notes.content:
I dream of vast, mesmerizing alien worlds, of lush and colorful alien reefs, and of deep and dark abysses. I’m in love with the sense of exploring the vast unknown, that which strikes both fear and wonder in the hearts of men. I dream of wonderful alien worlds, and this is what I want Exonautis to be.

We are launching a first Demo for the game! Try it out and offer as much feedback as possible, we listen to each and every one of our players. We are also launching a Kickstarter Campaign very soon to fund the development of the game. Supporting us through Kickstarter will allow us to create the best possible game and deliver so much more, so check out our Kickstarter page on launch!

Finally, I want to offer my biggest gratitude and thank you to everyone that has supported the game so far, your love for this game is what drives us. For more information feel free to join our discord at:

https://discord.gg/SASN3A2CXh


Much love, 

Petru
